limits: Synthetic offline fixtures do not establish successful device execution, staging or performance qualification.
Functional evidence consistency checks are not signatures or replay of every command and every performance field.
Source closure is checked at capture boundaries, not continuously; tool executables are not rehashed before every command.
The inherited collector buffers subprocess output without a hard byte limit; local admission and occupancy checks are not a shared device lock.
Timeout or interruption does not establish remote process exit; hashes are not signed provenance or mapped image attestation.
